summary: Verification round. review-scope exited 0: 1 of 43 blocks changed (2%), with no change to sections or objectives. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so there are no resolved entries. I reviewed the changed block, practice-steps, in full. Only the p-start expect changed: it now warns that the first start in a new folder shows the trust prompt and says to approve it because the learner made the folder. This matches cc-05 and cc-09 and the trust dialog in cross-lesson-facts.md, and it addresses the first-start part of the previous round's factual doubt. There are no errors or regressions, so there are no new must-fix items. Two nice-to-haves: the approve action belongs in md rather than expect, and the trust dialog needs a cited source (the security page). I re-scored load, practice and accuracy, all unchanged at 3. validate shows 0 errors and lint --strict 0 warnings. measure.mjs gives est 16.1 min (estMinutes 16) and prose 1659.
